links.outcome: Clinical usability of generative AI answers to MR safety requests versus human expert, by expert panel
links.effect: 93% (28/30) human, 50% (15/30) GAIO and 43% (13/30) ChatGPT responses deemed acceptable for clinical use; AIs significantly lower than human MRSE.
links.quote: Overall, 93% (28/30) of the human responses, 50% (15/30) of the GAIO responses and 43% (13/30) of the ChatGPT responses were deemed acceptable for clinical use.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Google AI Overview) against human experts for answering clinical MR safety queries using retrospective clinical requests evaluated by an expert panel.
